whenToUse: A mobile app has three to five top-level screens.
People move between those screens often.
You need to show counts of new items too.
whenNotToUse: There are six or more screens (put the rest under More).
On desktop screens (use top navigation or a sidebar).
You're switching views within one screen (use tabs or a segmented control).

alternatives.name: Mobile Menu
alternatives.reason: When there are many menu items.

accessibility: Always show a name under each icon.
The current screen has aria-current="page" and is marked with both color and weight.
Put the badge number in the aria-label, such as "3 new notifications", so it's read out.
Add safe-area padding to clear the home indicator.
